summary_of_pdf: Transcript of a telephonic communication between pro se Plaintiff Reinaldo J. Aguiar Marcano and a representative of the United States District Clerk's Office for the Southern District of Texas (Houston Division). The Plaintiff seeks to expedite the docketing of a motion for reconsideration regarding a denied application (Dkt. 10), citing an imminent eviction emergency. The Clerk's Office correctly declines to informally alter the default 21-day submission schedule and directs the Plaintiff to route his urgent communication to the presiding judge's case manager via the official Houston operations email.
attorneys_comments: From a procedural and tactical standpoint, this transcript illustrates the classic pitfalls of pro se litigation within the Southern District of Texas. The Plaintiff is attempting to secure expedited, emergency relief from an impending eviction but is failing to utilize the proper procedural mechanisms, such as filing a formally designated 'Emergency Motion' in strict compliance with SDTX Local Rules. The Clerk's Office representative acted with appropriate administrative restraint, correctly refusing to alter docketing deadlines or intake pipelines based on an informal, ex parte telephonic request. The Plaintiff's inability to reach the case manager (Cynthia Horace) by phone further underscores the necessity of adhering to formal electronic filing protocols and written requests for expedited consideration. The underlying substantive issue appears to involve a real property dispute, likely a foreclosure or eviction proceeding, which may implicate jurisdictional questions depending on whether it was removed to federal court or filed originally under diversity/federal question jurisdiction.
recommended_next_steps: The Plaintiff must immediately file a properly styled 'Emergency Motion for Reconsideration' that strictly complies with SDTX Local Rule 7, including a Certificate of Conference and a clear articulation of the irreparable harm (imminent eviction) justifying emergency consideration. Concurrently, Plaintiff should send a formal, written communication to houston_operation@txs.uscourts.gov, directed to the attention of Case Manager Cynthia Horace, attaching the filed emergency motion and copying opposing counsel to avoid improper ex parte communications.
